A VERY HONEST REVIEW GUYS ( PLEASE DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY AND TIME ON THIS HOTEL)
Rating: 1/5

Terrible Experience – Please Avoid!

My stay at this hotel was a complete disappointment.

Poor hospitality and extremely rude receptionist.

Location is bad and hard to access.

They changed my booking platform to OYO without consent and charged 15% more than the online price – a clear scam. (BOOKED IT FROM BOOKING.COM ACTUALLY)

No drinking water or beverages provided.

Bathrooms were filthy – foul-smelling, dirty toilet seats, and unhygienic environment.

The walls and infrastructure were in very poor condition – nothing like the photos shown online.

They even charged ₹100 extra for parking, which was never mentioned earlier.

Do NOT trust the images uploaded on booking sites. They are completely misleading.

Honestly, you’re better off sleeping in your car or at a friend’s place than staying here. A total waste of money and a very uncomfortable stay.

I had a very disappointing experience at Spot On The Arrow. The receptionist was extremely rude and had no manners in speaking to guests. He demanded ₹1000 extra without any valid reason and also charged additional parking fees. This kind of behavior is completely unprofessional and unacceptable.

The hospitality was poor, and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.
